findings.claim: n8n 2.47.7 is a non-prerelease release published on 2026-11-13 and tagged at commit d4dcb1b152a98fc31ea7c4ee6aecdc45c5c88063.
findings.notes: Version pin for this snapshot; not a claim this remains latest in perpetuity.

findings.claim: The tagged workflow structural validator checks nodes and connections, names/IDs, references and shape but does not check installed node type, parameter correctness, credential validity or activation readiness.
findings.notes: Inspected entire source file; comments explicitly identify excluded checks.

findings.claim: Native input structural validation requires name, type and position per node while accepting omitted id, typeVersion and parameters, but INode TypeScript interface requires the latter fields.
findings.notes: Also inspect packages/workflow/src/interfaces.ts INode; this is not proof of every endpoint DTO.

findings.claim: The n8n node OnError enum supports continueErrorOutput, continueRegularOutput and stopWorkflow.
findings.notes: Type declaration inspected; runtime semantics not yet exercised.

findings.claim: Connection map limit MAX_CONNECTION_INDEX is 1000 and MAX_DESTINATION_INPUT_SLOTS is 100000 in the tagged source.
findings.notes: Source inspected; not all runtime graph limits audited.

findings.claim: The n8n helper validateWorkflowHasTriggerLikeNode checks for recognized non-disabled polling, trigger or webhook-capable nodes.
findings.notes: A helper, not the entire publication validator pipeline.

findings.claim: n8n docs describe sub-workflows using Execute Workflow and Execute Sub-workflow Trigger, including explicit input-field and JSON-example input modes.
findings.notes: Live official documentation; recheck for target version.

findings.claim: n8n official error-handling docs state an error workflow begins with the Error Trigger, may be reused and receives different data for trigger-node failures.
findings.notes: Official docs, not an exhaustive runtime matrix.

findings.claim: n8n official docs warn exported workflow JSON can contain credential names/IDs and HTTP Request auth headers.
findings.notes: Apply sanitation before sharing any exported artifact.

findings.claim: Official n8n environment tutorial says Git push uses saved workflow versions and remote publication is separate; native source-control environments are Business/Enterprise features.
findings.notes: Edition availability may change; confirm on the target account.

findings.claim: Official queue-mode docs describe main instance, Redis and worker instances and note filesystem binary storage is unsupported in queue mode.
findings.notes: Also documented: workers need shared encryption key; verify deployment settings.

findings.claim: The community n8n-MCP README claims 3501 nodes, 2352 templates, workflow validation/testing, snapshot support and multi-instance integration.
findings.notes: Figures and functional claims are self-reported. README references n8n 2.46.7; audit target compatibility.

findings.claim: REA README advertises analysis of JavaScript/Electron and native applications via MCP and CLI.
findings.notes: Tool not installed or run in this documentation baseline.

findings.claim: Programmatic-style node creators may need to set pairedItem to preserve item lineage for downstream expressions.
findings.notes: Need Code-node and sub-node variants tested independently.

findings.claim: All production changes should require independent staging verification and an explicit production release approval policy.
findings.notes: Project-specific safety policy, not a native n8n constraint.

findings.claim: n8n-io/skills README contains 14 capability skills plus a routing meta skill, and documents session and MCP tool hooks.
findings.notes: Repository n8n-owned; functionality still requires checking installed agent/runtime.

findings.claim: The pinned n8n Workflow SDK README advertises typed workflow building, JSON-to-code generation, flow control and built-in validation.
findings.notes: Features documented in source README; no SDK runtime benchmark executed.

findings.claim: The pinned n8n Workflow SDK contains a guide for serving HTML single-page interfaces from webhooks.
findings.notes: Guide exists; browser/CSP and deployed behavior not tested.

findings.claim: The cQnce n8n community node README claims callback and polling approval modes, using n8n execution resume URLs.
findings.notes: Maintainer claims; callback security and target compatibility not independently tested.

findings.claim: The Guardian n8n community node README documents allow/deny/approval policy gates and an atomic intent claim pattern.
findings.notes: Maintainer claims; external policy and concurrency behavior not independently tested.

findings.claim: The n8n official creators directory lists prolific verified creators such as Rahul Joshi, David Ashby, Yaron Been, Harshil Agrawal and Davide Boizza.
findings.notes: Counts change; inspected individual profiles. Number of templates is not a quality metric.

findings.claim: The n8n-owned lifecycle skill requires workflow validation, connection inspection and runtime testing before publish.
findings.notes: Official skill instructions inspected, but no actual n8n execution performed.

findings.claim: n8n-as-code documents CLI/environment management, Git-oriented workflow pull/push, a separate TypeScript transformer and promotion dry-run.
findings.notes: Project README inspected; no GitOps end-to-end staging test. MIT license.

findings.claim: n8n-check documents running workflow exports in an isolated n8n engine with fixture HTTP mocks, assertion reports and GitHub CI action; runner defaults to n8n 2.41.7 unless selected.
findings.notes: Maintainer README examined; isolated runner and CI not independently executed. MIT license.

findings.claim: The official @n8n/cli README documents Public API workflows, execution, credential, project and table commands and machine-readable output.
findings.notes: Official package/README inspected at pinned commit; target API permissions and edition constraints not tested.

findings.claim: n8n-schema-generator declares older n8n-nodes-base/n8n-workflow package dependency ranges and advertises source-derived schema extraction with node/config validation.
findings.notes: Maintainer README and package.json inspected; version skew/skipped schemas have not been independently audited. MIT license.

findings.claim: n8n-schema-generator committed snapshot identifies n8n 1.120.10 and 428 nodes, not pinned project n8n 2.47.7.
findings.notes: Snapshot source checked; incompatible with exact target version unless regenerated.

findings.claim: n8n-schema-generator uses empty catch blocks in node/credential class loading and can skip extraction failures without reporting them.
findings.notes: Source inspected; actual number of skipped nodes unknown.

findings.claim: n8n-schema-generator server sets wildcard CORS and listens on PORT without passing localhost-only host; no authentication check found in HTTP route handler.
findings.notes: Source inspected; do not expose without isolation/authentication.

findings.claim: n8n-check Docker action runs with --network none and read-only workflow/case input mounts; runner uses n8n import:workflow and execute --rawOutput.
findings.notes: Code inspection only; no action runtime result established at this point.

findings.claim: n8n-check default Action/Docker n8n version is 2.41.7; action supports exact version selection; package CLI specifies Node >=24.
findings.notes: README/action/Dockerfile/package consulted; our smoke action explicitly selects 2.47.7.

findings.claim: n8n-as-code CLI documents that push on an already published n8n 2.x workflow may release the changed version; push --verify is a push, not dry-run.
findings.notes: Documented upstream and corroborated by packages/cli/src/commands/sync.ts.

findings.claim: Official @n8n/cli package version in n8n 2.47.7 source is 0.27.0 under LicenseRef-n8n-sustainable-use; CLI config writes API key file mode 0600.
findings.notes: Source/package/config.ts inspected; actual target instance permissions untested.
